channel.title: Godot on Striking Thoughts
channel.description: Recent content in Godot on Striking Thoughts

item.title: Nano-Escape
item.description: A Vampire Survivors inspired game with the twist on how your life, ammo, size, speed and the game music are tied together to scale up or down as you try to escape a factory compromised by a computer virus.

item.title: The Shader Journey
item.description: Ever since working with Tech Artists, I was fascinated by their work. I have been reading books and writing shaders to further my skills in game development.

item.title: Hopper
item.description: Made with love for my nephew, who is starting to love games. Used this opportunity to learn more about hooking up godot to the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store.
